cards.ex: We binge-watched the entire season of 'Stranger Things' last weekend.
cards.exUz: Biz o'tgan hafta oxiri 'Stranger Things'ning butun mavsumini maroq bilan ko'rdik.
cards.uzDef: Serial yoki filmlarni ketma-ket, tanaffussiz ko'rish.

cards.ex: The film is a loose adaptation of the classic novel.
cards.exUz: Film klassik roman asosida erkin moslashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Kitob, pyesa yoki shunga o'xshash narsaning filmga aylantirilishi.

cards.ex: That movie was a real tearjerker; I cried for half an hour.
cards.exUz: Bu film haqiqiy yig'latadigan edi; yarim soat yig'ladim.
cards.uzDef: Juda ta'sirli va yig'latadigan film, kitob yoki voqea.

cards.ex: The voice acting in that animated film was superb.
cards.exUz: O'sha animatsion filmdagi dublyaj juda zo'r edi.
cards.uzDef: Multfilmlar yoki o'yinlar uchun personajlarni ovozlashtirish.

cards.ex: I always watch the opening credits to see who the director is.
cards.exUz: Men har doim rejissor kim ekanligini bilish uchun titrlarni ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Filmning boshida ko'rsatiladigan yozuvlar, ismlar.

cards.ex: The episode ended on a cliffhanger, so I can't wait for the next one.
cards.exUz: Epizod tugun bilan yakunlandi, shuning uchun keyingisini kutaman.
cards.uzDef: Hikoyaning oxiri noaniq bo'lib, tomoshabinni qiziqtirib qoldiradi.

cards.ex: That music video went viral within a few days.
cards.exUz: Bu klip bir necha kun ichida virus kabi tarqaldi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda tez va keng tarqalib ketmoq (video, musiqa).

cards.ex: The background score really added to the atmosphere of the film.
cards.exUz: Musiqiy jo'rlik filmning muhitini yanada boyitdi.
cards.uzDef: Film, serial yoki o'yin davomida eshitiladigan musiqa.

cards.ex: Despite the hype, the movie turned out to be a box office bomb.
cards.exUz: Reklamalarga qaramay, film kassada muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta byudjetli, ammo kassada muvaffaqiyatsiz film.

cards.ex: Many consider 'War and Peace' to be a literary masterpiece.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik 'Urush va Tinchlik'ni adabiy durdona deb hisoblaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining yuksak sifati va ahamiyati bilan tanilgan ajoyib kitob.

cards.ex: I got a plot bunny while listening to the radio this morning.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab radiodan bir hikoya fikri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Hikoyaning asosiy fikrini keltirib chiqaradigan kichik g'oya.

cards.ex: Her new novel is a real page-turner; I finished it in one day.
cards.exUz: Uning yangi romani juda qiziqarli; men uni bir kunda tugatdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda qiziqarli kitob, o'qishni to'xtatish qiyin.

cards.ex: I'm completely tone-deaf, so I can't sing at all.
cards.exUz: Men umuman musiqiy qobiliyatsizman, shuning uchun umuman kuylay olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Musiqiy qobiliyati bo'lmagan, notalarni ajrata olmaydigan.

cards.ex: Some fans accuse the band of selling out when they started making pop music.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi muxlislar guruhni pop musiqa qila boshlaganida sotilib ketganlikda ayblashadi.
cards.uzDef: San'atkorning tijorat maqsadlarida o'z san'atiga xiyonat qilishi.

cards.ex: I often hum a tune while I'm working.
cards.exUz: Men ishlayotganimda ko'pincha xirgoyi qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Musiqani ovoz chiqarmasdan, lablar bilan kuylamoq.

cards.ex: Her latest album went platinum within a month.
cards.exUz: Uning so'nggi albomi bir oy ichida platinaga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Albomi juda ko'p nusxada sotilib, platina sertifikatini olmoq.

cards.ex: The band is planning to drop their new album next spring.
cards.exUz: Guruh kelgusi bahorda yangi albomini chiqarishni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yangi musiqiy albomni rasman chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: He was playing air guitar to his favorite song at the party.
cards.exUz: U ziyofatda sevimli qo'shig'iga havo gitarasi chalayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Gitarani chalayotgandek harakat qilish, aslida gitarasiz.

cards.ex: The concert was a total letdown; the sound quality was awful.
cards.exUz: Konsert umidsizlikka aylandi; ovoz sifati juda yomon edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan narsa sodir bo'lmaganda, umidlar puchga chiqishi.

cards.ex: She's such a bookworm; she always has her nose in a book.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik kitob qurti; har doim kitobga ko'milgan.
cards.uzDef: Kitob o'qishni juda yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: Some people believe there's a hidden message in the lyrics of the song.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilar qo'shiq matnida yashirin xabar borligiga ishonishadi.
cards.uzDef: Asarda ko'rinmaydigan, lekin ma'no anglatuvchi xabar.

cards.ex: The film is a sweeping epic about the rise and fall of an empire.
cards.exUz: Film imperiyaning yuksalishi va qulashi haqidagi keng qamrovli epikdir.
cards.uzDef: Katta qamrovli, tarixiy voqealarni tasvirlovchi film yoki kitob.

cards.ex: I can't carry a tune, so I never sing karaoke.
cards.exUz: Men qo'shiq ayta olmayman, shuning uchun hech qachon karaoke kuylamayman.
cards.uzDef: Notani to'g'ri ololmaslik, musiqa qobiliyatining yo'qligi.

cards.ex: The film received a mixed review; some loved it, others hated it.
cards.exUz: Film aralash baho oldi; ba'zilar uni yaxshi ko'rishdi, boshqalar esa yomon ko'rishdi.
cards.uzDef: Tanqidchilarning fikrlari bir xil bo'lmagan taqriz.

cards.ex: That album was ahead of its time; it's still relevant today.
cards.exUz: Bu albom o'z zamonidan o'zib ketgan edi; u bugungi kunda ham dolzarb.
cards.uzDef: G'oyalari, uslubi yoki texnologiyasi o'z davriga mos kelmaydigan.

cards.ex: This novel is a real page turner, I read it in one sitting.
cards.exUz: Bu roman juda qiziqarli, men uni bir o'tirishda o'qib tugatdim.
cards.uzDef: O'qishni to'xtatish qiyin bo'lgan, juda qiziqarli kitob.

cards.ex: The soundtrack to that movie is amazing.
cards.exUz: O'sha filmni soundtreki ajoyib.
cards.uzDef: Film uchun yozilgan musiqa to'plami, albom.

cards.ex: I usually stay until the closing credits to appreciate everyone involved.
cards.exUz: Men odatda barcha ishtirokchilarga minnatdorchilik bildirish uchun yakuniy titrlargacha qolaman.
cards.uzDef: Filmni oxirida ko'rsatiladigan yozuvlar, ismlar.

cards.ex: I love reading historical fiction; it's a great way to learn about the past.
cards.exUz: Men tarixiy badiiy asarlarni o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman; bu o'tmishni o'rganishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: O'tmish voqealariga asoslangan, badiiy to'qima asar.

cards.ex: That new band is all the rage among teenagers.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi guruh o'smirlar orasida juda mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Ommabop, mashhur yoki zamonaviy bo'lmoq.
